title: All day: Evening / Sunday open 18:00-20:00 - orb (H1 pick)
question: Owner 2026-10-23: start trading 24/7 - which setups work in each part of the NQ day, at the same or a higher win rate than LIT?
notes: tools/allday.py, variant orb|open18|30,bar|R1.5,None,eod; picked: H1 pick (2026 Jan-Jun, win % >= 50, plateau score)

rules: Window: Evening / Sunday open 18:00-20:00. Opening range = its first 30 minutes.
Entry: the first 5m close beyond the range, that way.
Stop: 1 tick beyond the breakout candle.
Time exit: flat 15:55 ET. One trade a day. Entry at the next 5m open + 1 tick; stop and time exits - 1 tick; $1.40 a micro.
Size: $800 risk up to a 20-pt stop, then 800 x 20 / stop (max 40 micros); stops 6-80 pts.

method: exact live-loop replay (20-day window per session) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included
